verdict.rationale: Spline ships an official MCP server, bundled in the desktop app, that connects coding agents such as Claude, Cursor and Codex directly to the open editor. The docs frame it as a way to drive and edit the editor, not to read design context for implementing the design. missing for 10: documented read access to frames, variables, screenshots and component mappings via MCP or API; evidence of the design-to-code implementation workflow; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can pull real design context — frames, variables, screenshots, component mappings — through an MCP server or API to implement the design

citations.quote: The **Spline MCP Server** connects AI coding tools like **Claude**, **Cursor**, **Codex**, and **Antigravity** directly to your Spline editor.
Spline MCP Server — drive Spline from Claude, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients, straight into your open editor tab.
**MCP** support for connecting AI coding tools to your editor
